### Fender Telecaster

Pickup Position: 3

### Zoom G3Xn ON

106 Princeton

Block 1 — RackComp (DYNAMICS)
THRSH: 25
Ratio: 3
ATTCK: 5
VOL: 100 (unity/pass-through — not a boost like RC Boost’s Volume)  
Block 2 — RC Boost (DRIVE)
Gain: 15
Bass: 50
Treble: 55
VOL: 65 (adjusted down from 100/max after A/B testing — 100 was a noticeable level jump, not a subtle push)   
OFF Block 3 — Tremolo (MODULATION)
Wave: TUBE
Depth: 35
Rate: 30
VOL: 100   
OFF Block 4 — FD Spring (REVERB) — sole reverb source (Option A)   
Active: ON
Color: 1
Lo: 55
Hi: 45
Mix: 30

### Joyo Tremolo

Intensity: 25%
Rate: 25%

### Fender Blues Jr. III

Volume: 4.5
Fat: OFF
Treble: 5.5
Bass: 4.5
Middle: 5.0
Master: 4.5
Reverb: 3.0

### Blue Yeti

Gain: 9 o’clock
Mode: Cardioid mode, 4” from speaker, slightly off-axis
